biography: Matheus Morgatto's journey began amidst the sun-drenched karting tracks of Brazil. Unlike many who were practically born in a cockpit, Matheus discovered racing relatively late, at the age of 12, during a family trip to a local karting event. The raw speed and visceral energy of the karts ignited a spark within him. He began honing his skills in 2-Stroke 125cc Direct karts, quickly becoming a formidable force. His early career was marked by intense dedication, spending countless hours perfecting his technique. In 2018, a near-fatal crash during a national championship race forced him to reassess his approach. This experience matured him, transforming him from a raw talent into a calculating strategist. Now at 22, Matheus is determined to prove he has the mental fortitude to complement his impressive natural abilities. He is currently seeking sponsorship to move into formula racing.
drivingStyle: Morgatto's driving style is characterized by a meticulous and calculating approach. He's not one for flamboyant overtakes or risky maneuvers. Instead, he focuses on precision and consistency, meticulously analyzing track conditions and opponent weaknesses. He excels at tire management, often preserving his rubber for a late-race surge. While some might view his style as cautious, it's a product of calculated risk assessment, a trait forged in the crucible of his near-fatal accident. He prefers to build momentum and capitalize on others' mistakes rather than force the issue.
